resources.name: Hultquist Library
resources.location: Hultquist Library (HULT), 260 Curtis Street, Jamestown, NY
resources.hours: Vary by day and semester. Check the library website for current hours.
resources.description: Campus library providing research materials, study spaces, and learning resources.

resources.name: Learning Center
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: HULT Floor 1, Learning Commons. Cattaraugus County Campus: LLAC Floor 1, Learning Commons
resources.description: Provides academic tutoring and learning support for students.

resources.name: Success Center
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: COCE Floor 1. Cattaraugus County Campus: COLL Floor 1
resources.description: Offers academic advising, course registration help, and counseling services.

resources.name: Financial Aid Office
resources.location: Jamestown Campus: COCE Floor 1. Cattaraugus County Campus: COLL Floor 1
resources.description: Assists students with financial aid, scholarships, and billing questions.

resources.name: Career Center
resources.location: Jamestown Campus and Cattaraugus County Campus (Olean)
resources.description: Helps students with career exploration, resumes, and job placement.

resources.name: Student Food Pantry
resources.location: Jamestown Campus, next to the Campus Bookstore, Hamilton Collegiate Center, first floor; Cattaraugus County Campus, Success Center across from the bookstore, College Center, first floor
resources.description: Provides food assistance to students facing food insecurity.

resources.name: JCC IT Help Desk
resources.location: Jamestown Community College; physical walk-in location not confirmed
resources.description: Provides technical support for student accounts, campus Wi-Fi, and computer issues.

resources.name: Campus Bookstore
resources.location: JCC Campus Store. 525 Falconer Street. Jamestown. NY 14701
resources.hours: Mon-Thu: 9:00 AM - 4:30 PM. Fri: 9:00 AM - 2:00 PM. Sat-Sun: Closed
resources.description: Sells textbooks, course materials, and campus merchandise.

resources.name: Campus Safety
resources.hours: Contact office or campus safety cell for active hours
resources.description: Provides security, emergency response, and safety escorts for the campus.

resources.name: Health Center
resources.location: Jamestown Campus | COCE 122; Cattaraugus County Campus | COLL 139
resources.description: Offers basic medical care, health assessments, and wellness resources.
